Final yearProject · Grade B+

Production of eco-friendly soap from tamarind seeds, banana peels and groundnut shells

Industrial Chemistry final year project

Addressed agricultural waste pollution by exploring how discarded plant materials can become useful, affordable and environmentally friendly soap products.

Agricultural waste→Oil extraction→Cold saponification→Eco-friendly soap

I prepared the waste samples, extracted oils using Soxhlet extraction, analysed chemical functional groups using FTIR spectroscopy, measured alkalinity through titration, and formulated the soap using cold saponification.

  • Soxhlet extraction
  • FTIR spectroscopy
  • Titration
  • Cold saponification
  • Muffle furnace
  • pH meter
  • Analytical balance
